name: Master Thief
languages: any one language (usually Common) plus thieves' cant

traits.name: Cunning Action
traits.text: On each of its turns, the thief can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.text: If the thief is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the thief instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.text: The thief deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the thief that isn't incapacitated and the thief doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The thief makes three attacks with its shortsword.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6+4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8+4) piercing damage.
